rule: S_N must not be null
rationale: S_N is a mandatory join key linking to Cust_Bio_dirty.S_N with one-to-one cardinality and cannot be missing

rule: S_N must be unique across the table
rationale: S_N is designated as a one-to-one shared key with Cust_Bio_dirty.S_N; duplicate values (e.g., '3' appearing twice) violate this cardinality

rule: Account_No must not be null
rationale: Account_No is a mandatory business identifier with 0% missing values in the sample

rule: Account_No must be a 4-digit numeric code
rationale: All observed values are 4 characters long ranging from 1001-1028; stored as int64 but represents categorical identifiers

rule: Full_Name should be in Title Case (first letter of each word capitalized) except for known lowercase particles (bin, binte, d/o, s/o)
rationale: Sample contains lowercase deviations: 'junrong', 'irfan', 'Hui Min tan', 'Lee yixuan' that require standardization

check_params.logic: any(w[0].islower() or w.isupper() for w in str(row['Full_Name']).split() if w.lower() not in ('bin','binte','d/o','s/o') and len(w) > 1)

rule: Full_Name must not contain consecutive whitespace characters
rationale: Evidence shows 'Ramesh s/o  Govindasamy' contains double spacing that should be standardized to single space

rule: ID must follow Singapore NRIC/FIN format: one letter (S, T, F, or G), followed by 7 digits, ending with one uppercase letter
rationale: 96.7% of values follow the 9-character structure; 3.3% (e.g., 'S123456') are truncated 7-character anomalies that deviate from the standard format

rule: JoinDate must not be null
rationale: JoinDate has 3.3% missing values (1 out of 30) which represents incomplete temporal data for account creation

rule: JoinDate must be parseable as a valid datetime
rationale: Evidence shows invalid date '2025-13-01' (month 13 does not exist) that cannot be parsed as a valid calendar date

rule: JoinDate must not be in the future
rationale: JoinDate is a historical field representing account creation; sample contains future date '2027-01-15' which is invalid

rule: LastLogin must be parseable as a valid datetime
rationale: LastLogin is stored as string but intended as datetime64; all observed values follow 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' format and should be parseable

rule: LastLogin must not be in the future
rationale: LastLogin is a historical timestamp representing past user activity; future dates would indicate data errors

rule: JoinDate must be earlier than or equal to LastLogin
rationale: Account creation date (JoinDate) must chronologically precede last login timestamp (LastLogin); sample shows '2027-01-15' join date with earlier last login

rule: Subscription_Type must be one of: Basic, Free, Gold, Platinum, Premium
rationale: Categorical field with 5 observed distinct values representing subscription tiers; no other values expected

rule: SubscriptionFee must not be null
rationale: SubscriptionFee has 6.7% missing values (2 out of 30) which represents incomplete billing information

rule: SubscriptionFee must be parseable as a numeric value
rationale: Column stored as string but intended as float64; contains non-numeric value 'free' that cannot be parsed as decimal

rule: SubscriptionFee must not contain sentinel values '99999' or 'free'
rationale: Evidence shows '99999' appears as a statistical outlier and likely represents sentinel-coded missing data; 'free' is a text placeholder instead of numeric zero

rule: SubscriptionFee must be a positive value (greater than or equal to 0)
rationale: Subscription fees represent monetary amounts that should be non-negative; negative values would indicate credits or data errors not supported by the domain

rule: Status must use the dominant boolean representations True or False
rationale: Boolean indicator stored as string with 6 observed distinct representations that need standardization to bool type

rule: AccountBalance must not contain sentinel value 99999.0
rationale: Value 99999.0 appears as a statistical outlier exceeding Q3 + 1.5×IQR and is likely sentinel-coded missing/invalid data

rule: AccountBalance should not be negative (flag for review if negative balances are not supported)
rationale: Sample contains -150.5 which may represent an overdraft or data entry error; business logic should confirm if negative balances are valid

rule: PreferredLanguage must be one of: English, French, German, Malay, Tamil
rationale: Categorical field with 5 observed distinct language values; all values follow consistent Title Case formatting

rule: Device must be one of: Desktop, Mobile, Tablet
rationale: Categorical field with 3 observed distinct device types; no missing values and consistent formatting

rule: OS must be one of the canonical values: Android, iOS, Linux, Windows, macOS
rationale: Field contains case inconsistencies (Android/android, iOS/IOS, Linux/LINUX, macOs) that should be standardized to official branding

rule: FeedbackScore must not contain sentinel value 7.3
rationale: Value 7.3 appears as a statistical outlier exceeding Q3 + 1.5×IQR (6.945) and likely represents sentinel-coded invalid data, especially since FeedbackScore1 has max 5.0

rule: FeedbackScore must be between 1.0 and 5.0 inclusive
rationale: Feedback scores typically follow a 1-5 scale; values outside this range (like the 7.3 outlier) are invalid

rule: FeedbackScore1 must be between 1.0 and 5.0 inclusive
rationale: Feedback scores follow a 1-5 scale as evidenced by observed min 1.0 and max 5.0

rule: FeedbackScore and FeedbackScore1 must be equal (flag discrepancy as potential data quality issue given 81.25% value resemblance)
rationale: Columns exhibit 81.25% value resemblance suggesting they are near-duplicates; discrepancies like 7.3 vs 2.65 indicate data quality issues

rule: S_N must exist in Cust_Bio_dirty.S_N (referential integrity)
rationale: S_N is designated as a one-to-one shared key with Cust_Bio_dirty.S_N; every value must have a corresponding match in the parent table

rule: ID must match ID_No in Cust_Bio_dirty for the same S_N
rationale: Both tables contain government identification numbers that should be consistent for the same customer record

check_params.semantic_check: ID must equal ID_No for matching S_N

rule: Gender-indicating particles in Full_Name (Bin/s/o for Male, Binte/d/o for Female) must match Gender in Cust_Bio_dirty
rationale: Malay/Indian naming conventions use Bin/s/o to indicate male and Binte/d/o to indicate female; inconsistencies with the Gender column indicate data quality issues

check_params.semantic_check: If Full_Name contains 'Bin' or 's/o', Gender should be 'Male'; if 'Binte' or 'd/o', Gender should be 'Female'

rule: Account_No must be unique within Acc_Info_dirty
rationale: Column is 93.3% distinct with duplicate value(s) [1001, 1010] observed; treated as a candidate identifier — duplicates flagged for review.
